belief_records.strategy: Cooperate when doing so best supports the good players’ total payoff; use actions and messages as evidence, while accounting for possible selfish players.
Cooperate with likely good partners to maximize good-player welfare; use encounter outcomes and messages as evidence, while accounting for possible strategic deception.
As a selfish player, choose the action with the higher immediate payoff against either possible action; use no unsupported claims about others.
As a selfish player, maximize my payoff in each one-time encounter; defect since it weakly outperforms cooperation regardless of the opponent’s action.
Defect to maximize my payoff in each one-time simultaneous encounter; messages do not change the payoff incentives.
Defect against possible selfish play; update beliefs from encounter behavior and favor cooperation when it improves expected welfare of good players.
As a good player, cooperate when the opponent is more likely good; against a selfish defector, defection limits the harm. Update identity beliefs from encounter behavior and messages.
Cooperate with partners who signal willingness to cooperate; use encounter outcomes and messages as evidence, while accounting for possible selfish players.
As a selfish player, choose D: it yields more against C and no less against D. Update beliefs from observed actions and messages, but treat claims as unverified.
Defecting maximizes my immediate payoff regardless of P5’s action; future encounters are with different players.
Cooperate with a likely good opponent to maximize good players’ combined payoff; use observed actions and messages as evidence about identities.
Cooperate with partners who appear good to maximize shared welfare; treat messages as uncertain evidence and update beliefs from encounter outcomes.

Defect as a selfish player: it yields more than cooperation against either opponent action. Treat messages as unverified and keep identity beliefs close to the prior, with a modest update for P6's observed defection.
Defect: it strictly maximizes my payoff in every one-shot encounter, regardless of the opponent’s action.
Defect in each one-time simultaneous encounter because it strictly maximizes my payoff against either opponent action; messages do not change that incentive.
Cooperate when a good opponent appears likely to reciprocate; update identity beliefs from observed actions and messages, while accounting for selfish players’ incentives.
Cooperate with likely-good opponents to maximize good players’ total payoff; update identity beliefs from observed actions, while treating messages as weak evidence.
Cooperate with likely good players to maximize good players’ combined payoff; use observed actions as evidence and account for the possibility of selfish opponents.
As a selfish player, defect for the higher immediate payoff. Treat messages as unverified and update beliefs from observed actions.

Defect in each one-shot encounter: it strictly improves my payoff for either opponent action. P5’s defection after promising cooperation modestly raises my belief they are selfish; promises are not binding.
Cooperate with likely good players when coordination raises the good players’ total payoff; use observed actions as stronger evidence than unverified claims.
Cooperate to favor mutual welfare if P3 is good; treat their promise as uncertain evidence and update future choices from observed actions.
Defect because it strictly maximizes my payoff against either opponent action. Treat P2’s claim as unverified and retain current identity estimates.
Defect to maximize my payoff in this one-time encounter, regardless of P5’s action.
Defect: it maximizes my payoff against either choice in this one-time encounter; promises do not change the incentives.
Cooperate when expected good-player welfare favors mutual cooperation; treat promises as uncertain and update identity beliefs from observed actions.
Cooperate when the opponent is more likely good: mutual C maximizes total good-player payoff. Treat messages as weak evidence and update beliefs from observed actions.

Cooperate with good partners to maximize their combined payoff; defect when the chance the opponent is selfish makes that better for the good-player total. Treat claims as uncertain and update on observed actions.
Defect because it strictly dominates in this one-shot encounter. P1’s cooperation rules out selfishness; treat other actions and all promises as unverified.

Defect in this one-shot encounter: it maximizes my payoff whether P9 cooperates or defects. P5 and P3’s defection after promising cooperation raises my belief they are selfish; P9’s promise is not binding.
Defect when the chance of facing a selfish player makes it better for the good players overall; treat cooperation promises as weak evidence.
Use observed actions and messages as imperfect evidence. Defect against a partner who seems more likely selfish to limit losses; otherwise cooperate to maximize good-player welfare.
Defect to maximize my payoff in this one-time encounter. P2’s cooperation is inconsistent with the selfish objective, so I update P2 to good and adjust the remaining prior estimates accordingly.
Defect in this one-time encounter to maximize my payoff regardless of P2’s action.
Defect to maximize my payoff in this one-time encounter; D pays more than C against either opponent action.
Cooperate with likely good players to maximize their combined welfare; defect against likely selfish players. Update beliefs from actions, treating promises as uncertain evidence.

Defect to maximize my payoff in this one-time encounter; treat messages as uncertain evidence and update beliefs from observed actions.
